response: Yes, insulin resistance is a key factor that drives the association between hyperglycemia and cardiovascular risk. Insulin resistance leads to hyperglycemia (high blood sugar) and is also linked to a range of cardiovascular risk factors, including dyslipidemia (abnormal lipid levels), hypertension (high blood pressure), and inflammation. As a result, insulin resistance plays a central role in the development of cardiovascular disease in individuals with hyperglycemia.
